## 📌 Pull Request Overview

### 🔗 Linked Issues
- Closes #[issue-number]
- Relates to Task #[task-number]

---

### 📝 Summary of Changes
- Implemented ...
- Configured ...
- Added tests for ...

---

### 🛡️ Branch Policy Checklist
- [ ] PR branch follows convention (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `release/*`)
- [ ] No direct commits to `main` allowed
- [ ] All Maven unit tests pass (`mvn test`)
- [ ] Selenium E2E automated test suite passes
- [ ] Jenkins CI pipeline status check is GREEN
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved by at least 1 peer reviewer
- [ ] Merge strategy: Squash and merge or Merge Commit with clean history

---

### 🧪 Testing & Verification
- Unit test coverage summary:
- Selenium journeys verified:
- Screenshots / Test execution logs attached:
